principle: Production readiness is not inferred from visual parity or TS build success; every public React component needs explicit API, runtime, interaction, accessibility, and family-specific evidence.

scope.includes: Direct public React component subpath exports only.
scope.excludes: Patterns, templates, docs shells, visual parity, and route-level documentation behavior.

policy.currentCertificationMode: tooling harness active; components become ready only with explicit per-component evidence.

toolingDecision.colorContrastInJsdom: disabled; JSDOM lacks reliable canvas-backed contrast evaluation
